pr_title: Disable lock and group buttons when selected item is not CanvasItem
pr_body:
An idea of fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/88939 , should be merged after https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/89132 is merged.

The origin problem lies in the fact that ParallaxBackground is not a CanvasItem so the code did not do anything special to it, I guess if this need to be fixed, we can either hide the button or make it disable. 

This pr disables lock and group buttons when there's not any selected CanvasItem.

pr_comments: While the report was only about 2D editor, the 3D one needs the same treatment, even for consistency.

I've rebased the code onto master, and added back `_update_lock_and_group_button` in `_draw_viewport`, to support update the lock button immediately after click it instead of next `selection_changed`.

When you click non-CanvasItem node, the lock button opens:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/2223172/6e8f495a-b66e-446b-a2fb-8a9769258ee3

It's inconsistent with empty selection, which is closed, and also suggests that non-CanvasItems are "locked". Probably worth fixing. It can be done with `all_locked = all_locked && has_canvas_item`.

EDIT:
Same in 3D.

issue_context.title: Cannot lock or group child nodes of ParallaxBackground
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

v4.2.1.stable.official [b09f793f5]

### System information

Godot v4.2.1.stable - KDE neon 5.27 22.04 - X11 - GLES3 (Compatibility)

### Issue description

Normally one can click on a node with children in the Scene panel of the editor and then click the Lock or Group buttons to prevent selecting or moving those children independently:

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/2385329/ef8b5d42-0471-4828-87c3-ace9597d6552)

However this isn't the case for the ParallaxBackground node... Clicking those buttons (which aren't disabled, so should be usable) doesn't do anything - child nodes (e.g. Sprite2D's) are still selectable and movable. I do notice however that the buttons are instead labelled Unlock and Ungroup...

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/2385329/80dab8a0-fef0-4fb2-b007-d4e97ae5094b)

If this is by design, I suggest making these buttons disabled for ParallaxBackground nodes to avoid confusion.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the 'parallax_test.zip' MRP below
2. Click and drag one of the icons in the editor to show they're not locked/grouped
3. Select the ParallaxBackground node in the Scene panel, then click on the Lock/Unlock and Group/Ungroup buttons
4. Notice the button icons don't change
5. Click and drag one of the icons in the editor to show they're still not locked/grouped

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[parallax_test.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/14426879/parallax_test.zip)
